page: Microsoft Azure E128ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors, the instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1024.0 GB of system memory, establishing an allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not feature discrete GPUs and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Storage configuration includes 7559 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity alongside support for Premium Storage. This integrated high-capacity NVMe array enables high-throughput, low-latency access for temporary files, local scratch space, and write-intensive caching operations.

By consolidating 128 execution threads, a terabyte of system memory, and direct-attached NVMe storage into a single virtual instance, hardware density is maximized for large-scale operations without external storage overhead for temporary files. The instance is structured for demanding enterprise applications, including in-memory databases, relational database engines, large analytical processing jobs, and extensive data transformation pipelines.
